issue.title: Basic remote server
issue.body:
This PR implements a basic remote server/client. In essence, the server provides a websocket connection to transfer files/stdout/stderr and runs commands in subprocesses. The client, based on the CLI arguments, uploads files and sends the json-serialized CLI arguments to the server to be executed.

The stdout capture doesn't capture progressbars unfortunately, so the UX isn't exactly the same as running locally.

The server tracks open probes and only allows a single access to each probe. This is currently done by exact probe selector comparison, so different selectors may still end up accessing the same device. This shouldn't be too hard to resolve (i.e. reject a VID:PID pair without serial when a VID:PID:Serial is already open), but the PR is big as is already.

We currently hard-code port 3000 for the same reason (PR is big).

We currently don't check server/client version compatibility. We probably should, and the user agent can be used to do it.

Host/token pairs will be added to the config presets in a later PR.

I did not try to make the debugger work remotely.

I was briefly toying with the idea of special-casing localhost, and detecting/connecting to a local server automatically via IPC. It wouldn't be terribly complicated to do, but it would probably be rarely needed, and at the same time would make the smoke tester setups awkward - CI would need to be able to force a run that doesn't attempt to connect to the local server, if it is running. So I ended up dropping the idea, while keeping the code in one of the commits.

comment.body:
Some users don't need cargo-embed, cargo-flash, or the dap-server either. Still, they are included.

While I agree a remote server doesn't _need_ to be included, right now setting up two new crates (one for the binary, one for shared functions with the CLI) to be published just to have it separate and save ~3MB on windows on the binary doesn't seem productive to me.

I think we should return to splitting this out once there is no more need to call out to the CLI from the server - until then it's better if they are the same binary and we don't have to deal with incompatibilities in this area.

pull_request.title: feat: Garbage collection TPS optimizations
pull_request.body:
# Ticket(s) Closed

- Closes #

## What

Some optimizations around `garbage_collect` in high insert/update scenarios:

1. **Compaction**: If `garbage_collect` renders entire pages in the linked list empty, they should be removed from the linked list (provided it's not the first page in the list). The pointer of the previous node then needs to be rewritten to point to the next non-empty page.
2. **Merge on insert**: Garbage collection now attempts to run during `merge_on_insert` (if a lock can be acquired).

Also introduces `paradedb.storage_info` and `paradedb.page_info`. `storage_info` returns all the blocks in the segment meta linked list and the max offset of each page. `page_info` returns information about every item for a particular block number.

In Stressgres, I'm seeing the linked list never growing beyond one page, and I'm also seeing 500+ TPS for SELECTs on my laptop (before it was around 200 TPS).

## Why

Prevents the linked list size from growing unbounded and decreasing throughput over time.

issue.title: Level 200: Swap Codebases
issue.body:
# Level 200

For level 200, you are not allowed to work on the same codebase as you worked on for level 100.

Swap repos with a random person in your class. You do not need to coordinate your schedules.

Fork their GitHub repository to your GitHub username. You will need to give it a different name (e.g. `Project-TV-Show-Partner`), because you already have a repo named `Project-TV-Show`.

Clone their repository to your laptop.

Look at their level 100 implementation.

Compare their implementation to yours. Think:
1. How is it different?
2. What do you prefer about your implementation?
3. What do you prefer about their implementation?
4. What did you learn that you didn't know before?

They should do the same with your repository.

Have a discussion about your answers to these questions. In class, together you should give a talk for 5 minutes about your conclusions. (Do this in small groups - we don't want to take all day).

## Refactoring

**Before implementing new features**, take some time to change the codebase you're going to build level 200 in. Change anything you think will make it easier to add more features.

Some example ideas that you may want to think about:
1. Could any variables or functions have more clear names, to help you understand what they do?
2. Would [extracting functions](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/refactoring) help make some code easier to understand?

Make a pull request to your partner's repo with any changes you want to make. Have them review, and when happy, merge your PR.

## Adding new functionality

Level 200 is all about being able to filter episodes.

### Search

Add a live search input which meets the following requirements:

When a user types a search term into the search box:
1. Only episodes whose summary **OR** name contains the search term should be displayed
2. The search should be case-**in**sensitive
3. The display should update **immediately** after each keystroke changes the input
4. Display how many episodes match the current search
5. If the search box is cleared, **all** episodes should be shown

Send a pull request to your partner's repo with this functionality. Have them review, and when happy, merge your PR.

#### Screenshot of minimal version

Note: Provided your project meets the above requirements, it can **look** however you want.

Here is one example layout.

![Screenshot of a website with a search term entered in the search box, and only matching episodes shown](https://github.com/CodeYourFuture/JS3-Module-Project/assets/42203406/aaedc73c-4f0b-45c9-9dd1-90724b9e00f1)


### Episode selector

Add a `select` drop-down which lets the user jump quickly to a particular episode, with the following requirements:
1. The select input should list all episodes in the format: "S01E01 - Winter is Coming"
2. When the user makes a selection, they should be taken directly to that episode in the list
3. Bonus: if you prefer, when the select is used, ONLY show the selected episode. If you do this, be sure to provide a way for the user to see all episodes again.

Send a pull request to your partner's repo with this functionality. Have them review, and when happy, merge your PR.

#### Screenshot of minimal version

Note: Provided your project meets the above requirements, it can **look** however you want.

Here is one example layout.

![Screenshot of a website with a drop-down listing all available episodes](https://github.com/CodeYourFuture/JS3-Module-Project/assets/42203406/796053da-65c0-434e-a957-341a974e9f36)

style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.5em;"><img src="http://fe.bnu.edu.cn/upload_dir/editor/2024/12/20/6b290ce5a4d2759452d88fa693001c4b.jpg" width="649" title="" alt="img_0201.jpg" height="490" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.5em;"><img src="http://fe.bnu.edu.cn/upload_dir/editor/2024/12/20/a2eba7de44e2a722c7fbb0f2a92a8678.jpg" width="641" title="" alt="img_0211.jpg" height="455" 16px;">教师教育研究院黄嘉莉教授认为，“国优计划”培养方案的课程架构和地图要凸显“跨学科”，结合时代趋势将人工智能相关内容融入课程；在课程实施、实践基地选择、导师确定等方面统一管理方向；同时加入表现性评价相关内容，体现培养的连贯性和一致性。</span></p><p style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.5em;"><img 16px;">教师教育研究院李琼教授从课程建设、实习实践、科学研究等三方面提出建议。在课程建设方面，统整“学位基础课”为专题课程，凸显“教师教育课程”这一特色，同时与综合性大学联合培养，结合综合性大学的学科特色和我校教育特色；在实习实践方面，建立优秀基地校，开展合作，充分利用资源，共同培养拔尖创新人才；在科学研究方面，申请国家社科项目、重点专项等，追踪学生的学习成果，形成可以全国推广的教师教育课程，凸显北师大的特色。</span></p><p style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.5em;"><img src="http://fe.bnu.edu.cn/upload_dir/editor/2024/12/20/b829a8cbd8c649b42feb7b8fa2a43d6b.jpg" width="633" title="" alt="img_0221.jpg" height="461" line-height: 1.5em;"><span style="line-height: 150%; font-family: 微软雅黑, "Microsoft YaHei"; font-size: 16px;">教师教育研究院叶菊艳副教授从教师教育专业角度出发，认为在培养理</span><span style="line-height: 150%; font-family: 微软雅黑, life的理念，将国家对于科技强国、创新的理念融入课程；第四，“强”整合、“强”交叉：即人文性与专业性的整合，将与人类命运共同体相关内容融入科学研究中。</span><span style="font-family: 微软雅黑, "Microsoft YaHei";">同时，构建</span><span style="font-family: 微软雅黑, "Microsoft line-height: 1.5em;"><img src="http://fe.bnu.edu.cn/upload_dir/editor/2024/12/20/4fed8958c1482733a162e9f3a0a70ecf.jpg" width="638" title="" alt="img_0229.jpg" height="489" style="width: 638px; height: 489px;" referrerpolicy="no-referrer"><span style="line-height: 150%; font-family: 微软雅黑, "Microsoft YaHei"; font-size: 16px;"> </span></p><p style="text-indent: 37px; line-height: 1.5em; text-align: left;"><span style="line-height: 150%; font-family: 微软雅黑, "Microsoft YaHei"; font-size:
